headline: Barcelona after Paris: still favourites for El Clasico
summary: El Clasico at Camp Nou comes five days after Barcelona's first defeat of the season, 4-2 in Paris on Tuesday. They still lead La Liga with 27 points, six more than the Real Madrid side that reports say Jose Mourinho now coaches. Madrid are set to be without Vinicius through suspension, but Barcelona have their own concern: Dani Olmo went off injured in Paris. Even so, the market makes Barcelona 59.4% favourites, though Madrid's chance has risen from 19.8% to 24.1% in recent days. The goal line sits at 4.18.
read: El Clasico at Camp Nou with Barcelona top of La Liga, six points clear of Real Madrid, but arriving off their first defeat of the season, 4-2 at PSG. Barcelona are 59.4% favourites, the market has tightened toward Madrid in recent days, and the goal line sits at 4.25 after both sides' free-scoring weekends.

facts.fact: Barcelona's 11-match winning run ended with a 4-2 Champions League defeat at PSG on Tuesday, their first loss of the season.
facts.meaning: Barcelona come into the Clasico off a defeat for the first time this season, five days before kick-off.

facts.fact: Barcelona lead La Liga with 27 points from nine games, unbeaten in the league.
facts.meaning: They host the Clasico as league leaders, with the gap to Madrid the prize on the line.

facts.fact: Barcelona are 59.4% favourites to win the Clasico, with the draw at 16.5% and Real Madrid at 24.1%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not a Barcelona win — but roughly two chances in five that it is not.

facts.fact: Real Madrid's chance of winning has risen from 19.8% to 24.1% in recent days.
facts.meaning: The market rates this Clasico closer than it did a few days ago, even with Barcelona at home.

facts.fact: Jose Mourinho returns to Camp Nou as Real Madrid coach, with his side six points adrift of the leaders.
Vinicius Junior is set to miss El Clasico plus two more league fixtures through suspension, with Real Madrid seeking provisional measures to reduce the ban.
facts.meaning: Madrid are facing the Clasico without one of their first-choice attackers down the left.

facts.fact: Barcelona midfielder Dani Olmo was forced off injured in the first half against PSG and replaced by Fermin Lopez.
facts.meaning: Barcelona's midfield is a fresh concern only five days before the Clasico.

facts.fact: Mundo Deportivo reports Barcelona are increasingly pessimistic about Jules Kounde being fit for the Clasico because of a serious ankle sprain.
facts.meaning: Barcelona's defence could go into the biggest game of the season short of a first-choice option.
